name: Jackie Chan WTF
look: A black-and-white rage-comic line drawing of Jackie Chan clutching both sides of his head, fingers buried in his hair. His brow is furrowed, his eyes squint and his lips are pushed out in a baffled, overwhelmed frown.
use: A reaction to something baffling or nonsensical. The caption describes logic that makes no sense, a confusing rule, or information too strange to process, and the face says what?
slots: the part that makes no sense (caption at bottom)
examples: The recipe says prep time: 10 minutes
Me reading my own handwriting from last week
